theorem good_pair_cover_mass (S T : Tree) (A B C : List Nat) (F : List (List Nat)) (q : Nat)
    (hs : (leaves S).Nodup) (ht : (leaves T).Nodup)
    (sameLabels : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves S ↔ x ∈ leaves T)
    (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) [A,B,C] = true)
    (hsource : pairwiseEmbeddings S [A,B,C] = true) (hAB : A ≠ B)
    (hover : ∃ v, v ∈ minimalVertices A T ∧ v ∈ minimalVertices B T)
    (clearOther : ∀ E, E ∈ [A,B,C] → E ≠ A → E ≠ B → Disj T E A ∧ Disj T E B)
    (hgood : restrictionAgrees S T A = true)
    (hF : agreement S T F = true) (hFP : RefinesBlocks F [A,B,C]) (hq : F.length-1 ≤ q)
    (c : Rat) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    (∃ F' o choice, PairGeometry.choose T A B = some choice ∧
      agreement S T F' = true ∧ F'.length ≤ F.length ∧ RefinesBlocks F' [A,B,C] ∧
      o ∈ goodPairOutputs S T A B q ∧ OutputWitness S [A,B,C] F' q o ∧
      ChoiceProgress S T A B o choice) ∧
    rawQMass c (goodPairOutputs S T A B q) ≤ c^(-3 : Int)+c^(-4 : Int) := by
  have hl : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves S → x ∈ leaves T := fun x hx => (sameLabels x).1 hx
  have hproper := proper_pair_from_partition S T A B C ht hl hp
  obtain ⟨choice,hchoose,hvalid⟩ := PairGeometry.choose_complete T A B hproper hover
  cases choice with
  | vertex v =>
    obtain ⟨hA,hB,hthree⟩ := hvalid
    obtain ⟨o,ho,hOut,hclear⟩ := vertex_pair_cover T S A B C F v q ht hs hl
      (agreement_swap S T F hF) hp hFP hA hB hq
    have hm := vertex_pair_three_mass S T A B C v ht hl hp hA hB hthree q c hc
    refine ⟨⟨F,o,.vertex v,hchoose,hF,Nat.le_refl _,hFP,?_,hOut,hclear⟩,?_⟩
    · simpa only [goodPairOutputs,hchoose] using ho
    · simpa only [goodPairOutputs,hchoose] using hm
  | edge e =>
    obtain ⟨u,F',o,hu,heq,hAF,hRef,hLen,ho,hOut,hClear,hKept,_,hMass⟩ :=
      selected_edge_good_parent_core S T A B C e F q hs sameLabels hp hsource hAB hchoose
        clearOther hgood hF hFP hq c hc
    have he := side_outputs_descendant S T u A B e.2 ht hu q
    have hm : rawQMass c (goodPairOutputs S T A B q) ≤ c^(-3 : Int) := by
      simpa only [goodPairOutputs,hchoose,he] using hMass
    have hpos : 0 ≤ c^(-4 : Int) := by
      change 0 ≤ (c^4)⁻¹
      exact Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (Rat.pow_pos (by grind)))
    refine ⟨⟨F',o,.edge e,hchoose,hAF,hLen,hRef,?_,hOut,⟨hClear,hKept⟩⟩,?_⟩
    · simpa only [goodPairOutputs,hchoose,he] using ho
    · grind

theorem kept_parent_of_refinement (S T : Tree) (A B C : List Nat)
    (F Q : List (List Nat))
    (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) [A,B,C] = true)
    (hA : A ∈ F) (hFQ : RefinesBlocks F Q) (hQP : RefinesBlocks Q [A,B,C])
    (hgood : restrictionAgrees S T A = true) :
    ∃ K, K ∈ Q ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ K ↔ x ∈ A) ∧ restrictionAgrees S T K = true := by
  obtain ⟨hab,hac,_⟩ := Assembly.parent_partition_disjoint S A B C hp
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := nonempty_witness A (partitionCheck_nonempty _ _ hp A (by simp))
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hAK⟩ := hFQ A hA
  obtain ⟨P,hP,hKP⟩ := hQP K hK
  have hKA : Sub K A := by
    simp only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at hP
    rcases hP with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact hKP
    · exact False.elim (hab x hx (hKP x (hAK x hx)))
    · exact False.elim (hac x hx (hKP x (hAK x hx)))
  have he : ∀ x, x ∈ K ↔ x ∈ A := fun x => ⟨hKA x,hAK x⟩
  refine ⟨K,hK,he,?_⟩
  have hS := restrict_congr S K A (fun x _ => he x)
  have hT := restrict_congr T K A (fun x _ => he x)
  simpa only [restrictionAgrees,hS,hT] using hgood

theorem selected_edge_good_parent_core (S T : Tree) (A B C : List Nat)
    (e : RMAF.Vertex × RMAF.Vertex) (F : List (List Nat)) (q : Nat)
    (hs : (leaves S).Nodup) (sameLabels : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves S ↔ x ∈ leaves T)
    (hp : partitionCheck (leaves S) [A,B,C] = true)
    (hsource : pairwiseEmbeddings S [A,B,C] = true)
    (hAB : A ≠ B) (hchoose : PairGeometry.choose T A B = some (.edge e))
    (clearOther : ∀ E, E ∈ [A,B,C] → E ≠ A → E ≠ B → Disj T E A ∧ Disj T E B)
    (hgood : restrictionAgrees S T A = true)
    (hF : agreement S T F = true) (hFP : RefinesBlocks F [A,B,C])
    (hq : F.length-1 ≤ q) (c : Rat) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    ∃ u F' o, treeAt T e.2 = some u ∧ F' = exchange A B F u ∧
      agreement S T F' = true ∧ RefinesBlocks F' [A,B,C] ∧ F'.length ≤ F.length ∧
      o ∈ sideOutputs S A B (leaves u) q ∧ OutputWitness S [A,B,C] F' q o ∧
      (∀ K, K ∈ o.partition → Sub K B → Disj T K A) ∧
      (∃ K, K ∈ o.partition ∧ (∀ x, x ∈ K ↔ x ∈ A) ∧ restrictionAgrees S T K = true) ∧
      (dedupNat ((leaves S).map (WholeSourceMass.taggedColor A B (fun _ => 0) (sideColor (leaves u)) (fun _ => 0)))).length = 4 ∧
      rawQMass c (sideOutputs S A B (leaves u) q) ≤ c^(-3 : Int) := by
  obtain ⟨hproper,hvalid⟩ := PairGeometry.choose_sound T A B (.edge e) hchoose
  have ht := PairGeometry.proper_nodup T A B hproper
  have hl : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves S → x ∈ leaves T := fun x hx => (sameLabels x).1 hx
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hEx⟩ := FreshPairReview.selector_edge_exchange S T [A,B,C] A B e hs sameLabels hp hsource
    (by simp) (by simp) hAB hchoose clearOther hgood F hF hFP
  dsimp only at hEx
  let F' := exchange A B F u
  change agreement S T F' = true ∧ RefinesBlocks F' [A,B,C] ∧ F'.count A = 1 ∧
    (∀ K, K ∈ F' → Sub K B → (∀ x, x ∈ K → x ∈ leaves u) ∨ (∀ x, x ∈ K → x ∉ leaves u)) ∧
    F'.length ≤ F.length ∧ outside A B F' = outside A B F at hEx
  obtain ⟨hAF,hRef,hCount,hMono,hLen,_⟩ := hEx
  have hq' : F'.length-1 ≤ q := Nat.le_trans (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hLen 1) hq
  have hparts := hAF
  simp only [agreement,Bool.and_eq_true] at hparts
  have hps : partitionCheck (leaves S) F' = true := hparts.1.1.1.1
  have hes : pairwiseEmbeddings S F' = true := hparts.1.2
  obtain ⟨hab,hac,hbc⟩ := Assembly.parent_partition_disjoint S A B C hp
  have hKeep : ∀ K, K ∈ F' → (∀ x, x ∈ K → x ∈ A) → LabelMonochromatic (fun _ => 0) K := by
    intros; intro x y hx hy; rfl
  have hKeepC : ∀ K, K ∈ F' → (∀ x, x ∈ K → x ∈ C) → LabelMonochromatic (fun _ => 0) K := by
    intros; intro x y hx hy; rfl
  have hSide : ∀ K, K ∈ F' → (∀ x, x ∈ K → x ∈ B) → LabelMonochromatic (sideColor (leaves u)) K := by
    intro K hK hKB
    exact side_mono_of_sector (leaves u) K (hMono K hK hKB)
  obtain ⟨o,ho,hFQ,hBudget⟩ := Assembly.tagged_whole_source_coverage S A B C F'
    (fun _ => 0) (sideColor (leaves u)) (fun _ => 0) hs hps hes hab hac hbc hRef hKeep hSide hKeepC q hq'
  have hQRef := Assembly.tagged_output_refines_parents S A B C _ _ _ q o ho hp hab hac hbc
  have hQ := Assembly.generated_source_valid S _ q o ho
  have hReal := CutRealization.generate_original_realization S _ q o ho
  change e ∈ PairGeometry.edges T ∧ e.1 ∈ minimalVertices A T ∧ e.1 ∈ minimalVertices B T ∧
    e.2 ∈ minimalVertices A T ∧ e.2 ∈ minimalVertices B T ∧
    (∀ i, PairGeometry.sideLabels A T e.2 i ≠ []) ∧
    (∀ i, PairGeometry.sideLabels B T e.2 i ≠ []) ∧ PairGeometry.ActualClear T A B e.2 at hvalid
  obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,_,hBs,hClear⟩ := hvalid
  have hBy : yes B ((leaves u).contains ·) ≠ [] := by
    rw [←FreshPairReview.side_yes B T u e.2 ht hu]; exact hBs true
  have hBn : no B ((leaves u).contains ·) ≠ [] := by
    rw [←FreshPairReview.side_no B T u e.2 ht hu]; exact hBs false
  have hyes : Disj T (yes B ((leaves u).contains ·)) A := by
    rw [←FreshPairReview.side_yes B T u e.2 ht hu]
    exact FreshPairReview.actual_clear_disj T _ _ (hClear.2 true)
  have hno : Disj T (no B ((leaves u).contains ·)) A := by
    rw [←FreshPairReview.side_no B T u e.2 ht hu]
    exact FreshPairReview.actual_clear_disj T _ _ (hClear.2 false)
  have hAin : A ∈ F' := List.count_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
  exact ⟨u,F',o,hu,rfl,hAF,hRef,hLen,ho,⟨hFQ,hQRef,hQ.1,hQ.2,hReal,hBudget⟩,
    side_output_clear S T A B C (leaves u) q o ho hp hyes hno,
    kept_parent_of_refinement S T A B C F' o.partition hp hAin hFQ hQRef hgood,
    side_input_color_count S T A B C (leaves u) hp ht hl hBy hBn,
    side_raw_mass S T A B C (leaves u) hp ht hl hBy hBn q c hc⟩

      VertexPairClearing T o.partition A B v := by

  have own := ownership_from_original_agreement T S F (Assembly.parentGroups F A B) hf
    (Assembly.parentGroups_belongs F A B) (Assembly.parentGroups_disjoint F A B)
  have both := two_parent_ownership_cover (PieceHulls T (Assembly.parentGroups F A B)) own 0 1 (by decide) v
  have build := Assembly.solution_from_requests T S A B C F
  rcases both with h | h

    have sol := Assembly.branch_is_source_forest (build (.at v) .keep .keep q ht hs hl hf hp hab hac hbc hr

    (ht : (leaves T).Nodup) (hl : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves S → x ∈ leaves T)

    (hthree : (regions A T v).length=3 ∨ (regions B T v).length=3)
    (q : Nat) (c : Rat) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    rawQMass c (vertexPairOutputs S T A B v q) ≤ c^(-3 : Int)+c^(-4 : Int) := by
  have hm := partition_mass_interface S T A B C hp ht hl
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,_⟩ := WholeSourceMass.partition_target_support S T A B C hm.partition hl
  have hn := disjoint_parent_overlap_nonlabel A B T v hm.partition.ab hA hB
  have hca := WholeSourceMass.original_colors_at_least_two A T v ht ha hn.1 hA
  have hcb := WholeSourceMass.original_colors_at_least_two B T v ht hb hn.2 hB
  have hza := WholeSourceMass.localColors_zero A hm.aNonempty
  have hzb := WholeSourceMass.localColors_zero B hm.bNonempty
  have hzc := WholeSourceMass.localColors_zero C hm.cNonempty

theorem hard_parent_embeddings {S : Tree} (hs : (leaves S).Nodup)
    {p r : RMAF.Vertex} (h : HardParent.LiteralOriginalThree S p r) :
    pairwiseEmbeddings S [leftParent S p,rightParent S r,rootParent S p r] = true := by

    [(p,leftParent S p),(r,rightParent S r),([],rootParent S p r)]
  have hc : ∀ v L, (v,L) ∈ cs → ComponentLabels S [p,r] v L := by
    intro v L hm
    simp only [cs,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false,Prod.mk.injEq] at hm
    rcases hm with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    · exact component_of_literal_leafset hs _ _ _ h.actual_left h.nonempty_left (fun x => (h.leafsets x).1)
    · exact component_of_literal_leafset hs _ _ _ h.actual_right h.nonempty_right (fun x => (h.leafsets x).2.1)

  have hn : (cs.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by
    simp [cs,h.distinct,h.nonroot_left,h.nonroot_right]
  have hsep : ∀ v, v ∈ cs.map Prod.fst → ∀ w, w ∈ cs.map Prod.fst → ResidualWalk S [p,r] v w → v=w := by
    intro v hv w hw hwalk
    apply h.separated v w _ _ hwalk
    · simpa [cs,or_comm,or_left_comm,or_assoc] using hv
    · simpa [cs,or_comm,or_left_comm,or_assoc] using hw
  exact Assembly.components_pairwise_embeddings S [p,r] cs hc hn hsep

theorem selector_edge_exchange (s t : Tree) (P : List (List Nat))
    (A B : List Nat) (e : RMAF.Vertex × RMAF.Vertex)
    (hs : (leaves s).Nodup)
    (sameLabels : ∀ x, x ∈ leaves s ↔ x ∈ leaves t)
    (hP : partitionCheck (leaves s) P = true)
    (hPS : pairwiseEmbeddings s P = true)
    (hAP : A ∈ P) (hBP : B ∈ P) (hAB : A ≠ B)
    (hchoose : PairGeometry.choose t A B = some (.edge e))
    (clearOther : ∀ E, E ∈ P → E ≠ A → E ≠ B → Disj t E A ∧ Disj t E B)
    (hA : restrictionAgrees s t A = true)
    (F : List (List Nat)) (hF : agreement s t F = true) (hf : Refines F P) :
    ∃ u, treeAt t e.2 = some u ∧
      (let F' := exchange A B F u
       agreement s t F' = true ∧ Refines F' P ∧ F'.count A = 1 ∧
       (∀ C, C ∈ F' → Sub C B →
         (∀ x, x ∈ C → x ∈ leaves u) ∨ (∀ x, x ∈ C → x ∉ leaves u)) ∧
       F'.length ≤ F.length ∧ outside A B F' = outside A B F) := by
  obtain ⟨hp,hvalid⟩ := PairGeometry.choose_sound t A B (.edge e) hchoose
  have ht := PairGeometry.proper_nodup t A B hp
  change e ∈ PairGeometry.edges t ∧ e.1 ∈ minimalVertices A t ∧ e.1 ∈ minimalVertices B t ∧
    e.2 ∈ minimalVertices A t ∧ e.2 ∈ minimalVertices B t ∧
    (∀ inside, PairGeometry.sideLabels A t e.2 inside ≠ []) ∧
    (∀ inside, PairGeometry.sideLabels B t e.2 inside ≠ []) ∧
    PairGeometry.ActualClear t A B e.2 at hvalid
  obtain ⟨he,hap,hbp,hav,hbv,has,hbs,hclear⟩ := hvalid
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := original_vertex_treeAt t e.2 (PairGeometry.minimal_vertices A t e.2 hav)
  have hne : e.2 ≠ [] := by
    obtain ⟨p,b,hshape⟩ := PairGeometry.edges_shape t e he
    rw [hshape]
    simp
  have hAy : yes A ((leaves u).contains ·) ≠ [] := by
    rw [← side_yes A t u e.2 ht hu]
    exact has true
  have hAn : no A ((leaves u).contains ·) ≠ [] := by
    rw [← side_no A t u e.2 ht hu]
    exact has false
  have hBy : yes B ((leaves u).contains ·) ≠ [] := by
    rw [← side_yes B t u e.2 ht hu]
    exact hbs true
  have hBn : no B ((leaves u).contains ·) ≠ [] := by
    rw [← side_no B t u e.2 ht hu]
    exact hbs false
  have hAm : mixed A ((leaves u).contains ·) = true := by
    simpa only [mixed,Bool.and_eq_true,Bool.not_eq_true',isEmpty_false] using And.intro hAy hAn
  have hBm : mixed B ((leaves u).contains ·) = true := by
    simpa only [mixed,Bool.and_eq_true,Bool.not_eq_true',isEmpty_false] using And.intro hBy hBn
  have cay : Disj t (yes A ((leaves u).contains ·)) B := by
    rw [← side_yes A t u e.2 ht hu]
    exact actual_clear_disj t _ _ (hclear.1 true)
  have can : Disj t (no A ((leaves u).contains ·)) B := by
    rw [← side_no A t u e.2 ht hu]
    exact actual_clear_disj t _ _ (hclear.1 false)
  have cby : Disj t (yes B ((leaves u).contains ·)) A := by
    rw [← side_yes B t u e.2 ht hu]
    exact actual_clear_disj t _ _ (hclear.2 true)
  have cbn : Disj t (no B ((leaves u).contains ·)) A := by
    rw [← side_no B t u e.2 ht hu]
    exact actual_clear_disj t _ _ (hclear.2 false)
  exact ⟨u,hu,binary_exchange s t u P A B e.2 hs ht sameLabels hP hPS hAP hBP hAB
    hne hu hAm hBm cay can cby cbn clearOther hA F hF hf⟩

theorem descendants_treeAt (t u : Tree) (v : RMAF.Vertex)
    (hn : (leaves t).Nodup) (hu : treeAt t v = some u) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ PairGeometry.descendants t v ↔ x ∈ leaves u := by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    obtain ⟨hxt,hpre⟩ := (PairGeometry.descendants_mem t v x).1 hd
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (singleton_selected_exists t x).2 hxt
    have haddr := PairGeometry.leafAddress_correct t x hn a ha
    exact (selected_descendant_iff t u v a x hn hu ha).1 (by simpa [haddr] using hpre)
  · intro hxu
    have hxt := treeAt_mem t u v hu x hxu
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (singleton_selected_exists t x).2 hxt
    have haddr := PairGeometry.leafAddress_correct t x hn a ha
    apply (PairGeometry.descendants_mem t v x).2
    exact ⟨hxt,by simpa [haddr] using (selected_descendant_iff t u v a x hn hu ha).2 hxu⟩

def OutputWitness (S : Tree) (P F : List (List Nat)) (q : Nat) (o : Output) : Prop :=
  RefinesBlocks F o.partition ∧ RefinesBlocks o.partition P ∧
  partitionCheck (leaves S) o.partition = true ∧ pairwiseEmbeddings S o.partition = true ∧
  CutRealization.RealizedOutput S o ∧ o.sourceCuts.length ≤ q

def RealizedOutput (T : Tree) (o : Output) : Prop :=
  GoodCuts o.sourceCuts ∧
  (∀ p, p ∈ o.sourceCuts → Valid T p) ∧
  ∃ components : List (RMAF.Vertex × List Nat),
    components.map Prod.fst = o.sourceCuts ++ [[]] ∧
    components.map Prod.snd = o.partition ∧
    (∀ r L, (r,L) ∈ components → ComponentLabels T o.sourceCuts r L) ∧
    (components.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    (∀ v, Valid T v → ∃ r, r ∈ components.map Prod.fst ∧ ResidualWalk T o.sourceCuts r v) ∧
    (∀ r, r ∈ components.map Prod.fst → ∀ s, s ∈ components.map Prod.fst →
      (ResidualWalk T o.sourceCuts r s ↔ r = s)) ∧
    (∀ v, Valid T v → ∃ a x, LeafAt T a x ∧ ResidualWalk T o.sourceCuts v a) ∧
    o.partition.length = o.sourceCuts.length + 1

structure LiteralOriginalThree (S : Tree) (q r : RMAF.Vertex) : Prop where
  actual_left : Valid S q
  actual_right : Valid S r
  nonroot_left : q ≠ []
  nonroot_right : r ≠ []
  distinct : q ≠ r
  left_component : ∀ v, ResidualWalk S [q,r] q v ↔ Valid S v ∧ q <+: v
  right_component : ∀ v, ResidualWalk S [q,r] r v ↔ Valid S v ∧ r <+: v
  root_component : ∀ v, ResidualWalk S [q,r] [] v ↔ Valid S v ∧ ¬q <+: v ∧ ¬r <+: v
  covers : ∀ v, Valid S v → ∃ c, c ∈ [[],q,r] ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] c v
  separated : ∀ c d, c ∈ [[],q,r] → d ∈ [[],q,r] → ResidualWalk S [q,r] c d → c = d
  leafsets : ∀ x,
    (x ∈ subtreeLabels S q ↔ ∃ v, LeafAt S v x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] q v) ∧
    (x ∈ subtreeLabels S r ↔ ∃ v, LeafAt S v x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] r v) ∧
    (x ∈ (leaves S).filter (fun y => !(subtreeLabels S q).contains y && !(subtreeLabels S r).contains y) ↔
      ∃ v, LeafAt S v x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] [] v)
  nonempty_left : subtreeLabels S q ≠ []
  nonempty_right : subtreeLabels S r ≠ []
  nonempty_root : (leaves S).filter (fun y => !(subtreeLabels S q).contains y && !(subtreeLabels S r).contains y) ≠ []
  no_leafless : ∀ v, Valid S v → ∃ w x, LeafAt S w x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] v w

theorem literalOriginalThree_construct {S : Tree} {a b : Nat} {q r : RMAF.Vertex}
    (hn : (leaves S).Nodup) (ha : a ∈ leaves S)
    (hq : q ∈ pendantOriginal S a b) (hr : r ∈ pendantOriginal S a b)
    (hne : q ≠ r) : LiteralOriginalThree S q r := by
  have hq' := (pendantOriginal_spec S a b q).1 hq
  have hr' := (pendantOriginal_spec S a b r).1 hr
  have hab := pendant_incomparable hq hr hne
  have qself : Region [q,r] q q := ⟨List.prefix_rfl,fun _ _ h => h⟩
  have rself : Region [q,r] r r := ⟨List.prefix_rfl,fun _ _ h => h⟩
  have zself : Region [q,r] [] [] := ⟨List.prefix_rfl,fun _ _ h => h⟩
  have hqc : ∀ v, ResidualWalk S [q,r] q v ↔ Valid S v ∧ q <+: v := by
    intro v
    rw [region_component (Or.inr (by simp)) hq'.1 qself,
      antichain_region_left hab.1 hab.2]
  have hrc : ∀ v, ResidualWalk S [q,r] r v ↔ Valid S v ∧ r <+: v := by
    intro v
    rw [region_component (Or.inr (by simp)) hr'.1 rself,
      antichain_region_right hab.1 hab.2]
  have hzc : ∀ v, ResidualWalk S [q,r] [] v ↔ Valid S v ∧ ¬q <+: v ∧ ¬r <+: v := by
    intro v
    rw [region_component (Or.inl rfl) (valid_root S) zself,
      two_region_root hq'.2.1 hr'.2.1]
  have hcover : ∀ v, Valid S v → ∃ c, c ∈ [[],q,r] ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] c v := by
    intro v hv
    by_cases hqp : q <+: v
    · exact ⟨q,by simp,(hqc v).2 ⟨hv,hqp⟩⟩
    · by_cases hrp : r <+: v
      · exact ⟨r,by simp,(hrc v).2 ⟨hv,hrp⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨[],by simp,(hzc v).2 ⟨hv,hqp,hrp⟩⟩
  have leafsets : ∀ x,
      (x ∈ subtreeLabels S q ↔ ∃ v, LeafAt S v x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] q v) ∧
      (x ∈ subtreeLabels S r ↔ ∃ v, LeafAt S v x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] r v) ∧
      (x ∈ (leaves S).filter (fun y => !(subtreeLabels S q).contains y && !(subtreeLabels S r).contains y) ↔
        ∃ v, LeafAt S v x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] [] v) := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [subtreeLabels_prefix]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨v,hv,hp⟩; exact ⟨v,hv,(hqc v).2 ⟨hv.valid,hp⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨v,hv,hw⟩; exact ⟨v,hv,((hqc v).1 hw).2⟩
    · rw [subtreeLabels_prefix]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨v,hv,hp⟩; exact ⟨v,hv,(hrc v).2 ⟨hv.valid,hp⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨v,hv,hw⟩; exact ⟨v,hv,((hrc v).1 hw).2⟩
    · constructor
      · intro hx
        have hx' : x ∈ leaves S ∧ x ∉ subtreeLabels S q ∧ x ∉ subtreeLabels S r := by simpa using hx
        obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := leaf_exists hx'.1
        exact ⟨v,hv,(hzc v).2 ⟨hv.valid,
          fun hp => hx'.2.1 ((subtreeLabels_prefix S q x).2 ⟨v,hv,hp⟩),
          fun hp => hx'.2.2 ((subtreeLabels_prefix S r x).2 ⟨v,hv,hp⟩)⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨v,hv,hw⟩
        have hp := (hzc v).1 hw
        have one : ∀ c, ¬c <+: v → x ∉ subtreeLabels S c := by
          intro c hc hx
          obtain ⟨w,hw,hwc⟩ := (subtreeLabels_prefix S c x).1 hx
          exact hc ((leaf_unique hn hw hv) ▸ hwc)
        have hqx := one q hp.2.1
        have hrx := one r hp.2.2
        simp [leafAt_label S v x hv,hqx,hrx]
  have hqne := subtreeLabels_nonempty hq'.1
  have hrne := subtreeLabels_nonempty hr'.1
  have haroot : a ∈ (leaves S).filter (fun y => !(subtreeLabels S q).contains y && !(subtreeLabels S r).contains y) := by
    have haq := source_label_outside_pendant hq (Or.inl rfl) ha
    have har := source_label_outside_pendant hr (Or.inl rfl) ha
    simp [ha,haq,har]
  have rootne : (leaves S).filter (fun y => !(subtreeLabels S q).contains y && !(subtreeLabels S r).contains y) ≠ [] := by
    intro he
    rw [he] at haroot
    exact List.not_mem_nil haroot
  have rootleaf : ∃ w x, LeafAt S w x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] [] w := by
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := (leafsets a).2.2.1 haroot
    exact ⟨w,a,hw⟩
  have qleaf : ∃ w x, LeafAt S w x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] q w := by
    cases he : subtreeLabels S q with
    | nil => exact False.elim (hqne he)
    | cons x xs =>
      obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := (leafsets x).1.1 (by simp [he])
      exact ⟨w,x,hw⟩
  have rleaf : ∃ w x, LeafAt S w x ∧ ResidualWalk S [q,r] r w := by
    cases he : subtreeLabels S r with
    | nil => exact False.elim (hrne he)
    | cons x xs =>
      obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := (leafsets x).2.1.1 (by simp [he])
      exact ⟨w,x,hw⟩
  refine ⟨hq'.1,hr'.1,hq'.2.1,hr'.2.1,hne,hqc,hrc,hzc,hcover,?_,leafsets,hqne,hrne,rootne,?_⟩
  · intro c d hc hd hw
    have croots : c = [] ∨ c ∈ [q,r] := by simpa using hc
    have droots : d = [] ∨ d ∈ [q,r] := by simpa using hd
    have cself : Region [q,r] c c := ⟨List.prefix_rfl,fun _ _ h => h⟩
    have dself : Region [q,r] d d := ⟨List.prefix_rfl,fun _ _ h => h⟩
    have hreg := ((region_component croots hw.start cself).1 hw).2
    exact rooted_regions_disjoint croots droots hreg dself
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨c,hc,hw⟩ := hcover v hv
    simp only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at hc
    rcases hc with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · obtain ⟨w,x,hl,hw'⟩ := rootleaf
      exact ⟨w,x,hl,hw.reverse.trans hw'⟩
    · obtain ⟨w,x,hl,hw'⟩ := qleaf
      exact ⟨w,x,hl,hw.reverse.trans hw'⟩
    · obtain ⟨w,x,hl,hw'⟩ := rleaf
      exact ⟨w,x,hl,hw.reverse.trans hw'⟩
